description: DataSpecificationIec61360 facts as formalised in aas-core-meta and the official schemas: langString length limits, AASc-3a-* constraints and their exceptions, dataType enum, levelType, removed AASd category rules, the data-specification IRI.

items.question: What is the maximum length of a preferredName text (per language) in DataSpecificationIec61360, and what length is advised?
items.expected_answer: At most 255 characters per langString (LangStringPreferredNameTypeIec61360); it is advised to keep the name to 35 characters.

citation.document: IDTA-01003-a Part 3a Data Specification IEC 61360 (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: String with length 255 maximum and minimum 1 characters and with language tags

items.question: What is the maximum length of a shortName text (per language) in DataSpecificationIec61360?

citation.document: IDTA-01003-a Part 3a Data Specification IEC 61360 (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: String with length 18 maximum and minimum 1 characters and with language tags

items.question: We want to paste a 3,000-character prose definition into a ConceptDescription's IEC 61360 definition (one language). Is the definition text length unbounded?
items.expected_answer: No. A LangStringDefinitionTypeIec61360 text has a maximum length of 1023 characters (minimum 1), so a 3,000-character definition is invalid; shorten it.

citation.document: IDTA-01003-a Part 3a Data Specification IEC 61360 (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: String with length 1023 maximum and minimum 1 characters and with language tags

items.question: A ConceptDescription's IEC 61360 preferredName exists only in German ('Herstellername'). Which constraint does that touch?
items.expected_answer: AASc-3a-002: the preferredName shall be provided at least in English, so a German-only preferredName violates it.

citation.document: IDTA-01003-a Part 3a Data Specification IEC 61360 (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: shall be provided at least in English.

items.question: Our checker flags every ConceptDescription whose DataSpecificationIec61360 has a value (a value CD) but no definition, citing AASc-3a-008. Is that correct?
items.expected_answer: No. AASc-3a-008 makes the definition mandatory (at least in English) with an exception: the concept description describes a value, i.e. its value is defined. Value CDs need no definition.

citation.document: IDTA-01003-a Part 3a Data Specification IEC 61360 (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: Exception: The concept description describes a value.

items.question: A ConceptDescription declares dataType REAL_MEASURE in its IEC 61360 data specification but has neither unit nor unitId. Is that valid?
items.expected_answer: No. AASc-3a-009: if the data type is an integer, real or rational measure or a currency (INTEGER_MEASURE, REAL_MEASURE, RATIONAL_MEASURE, INTEGER_CURRENCY, REAL_CURRENCY), unit or unitId shall be defined.

citation.document: IDTA-01003-a Part 3a Data Specification IEC 61360 (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: a measure or currency, unit or unit ID shall be defined.

items.question: What does AASc-3a-010 require, and may an IEC 61360 data specification leave both value and valueList empty?
items.expected_answer: AASc-3a-010: if value is not empty then valueList shall be empty, and vice versa. Both empty is allowed (a CD that defines a property without an enumeration). It is not a language-uniqueness rule.

citation.document: IDTA-01003-a Part 3a Data Specification IEC 61360 (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: It is also possible that both :attr:`value` and :attr:`value_list` are empty.

items.question: Which IEC 61360 dataType values are allowed for a ConceptDescription with category REFERENCE?

citation.document: IDTA-01003-a Part 3a Data Specification IEC 61360 (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: shall be one of: STRING, IRI, IRDI.

items.question: Which IEC 61360 dataType values are allowed for a ConceptDescription with category DOCUMENT?

citation.document: IDTA-01003-a Part 3a Data Specification IEC 61360 (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: shall be one of: FILE, BLOB, HTML.

items.question: Which DataTypeIec61360 enumeration value should a ConceptDescription use for a property whose values are web URLs?
items.expected_answer: IRI: the IRI data type (values conformant to RFC 3987) allows in particular to express a URL or a URI.

citation.document: IDTA-01003-a Part 3a Data Specification IEC 61360 (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.quote: An IRI type allows in particular to express an URL or an URI.

items.question: In an AAS 3.1 XML document, in which order must the four levelType flags be serialised?
items.expected_answer: min, nom, typ, max — an xs:sequence of four xs:boolean elements, each required once levelType is present.

citation.quote: <xs:element name="min" type="xs:boolean"/> <xs:element name="nom" type="xs:boolean"/> <xs:element name="typ" type="xs:boolean"/> <xs:element name="max" type="xs:boolean"/>

items.question: A ConceptDescription's levelType has min=true and max=true (nom and typ false). To which submodel element type does the AAS map this concept?
items.expected_answer: A Range (min and max set to true map the concept to a Range).

citation.document: IDTA-01003-a Part 3a Data Specification IEC 61360 (as formalised in aas-core-meta)
citation.section: class Level_type, note on level-type combinations
citation.quote: Min and max are set to true. In this case the concept is mapped

items.question: Should a 3.x validator report AASd-067 when the ConceptDescription referenced by a MultiLanguageProperty uses dataType STRING instead of STRING_TRANSLATABLE?
items.expected_answer: No. AASd-067 was removed (Part 1 V3.0 change table, V3.0RC02 vs. V3.0RC01: 'removed, still recommended'). STRING_TRANSLATABLE for an MLP's CD is a recommendation, not a numbered violation.

citation.section: Annex (Metamodel Changes), Changes V3.0RC02 vs. V3.0RC01, constraint table row AASd-067
citation.quote: AASd-067 Removed removed, still recommended; would be renamed to AASc if still needed

items.question: Constraint AASc-3a-050 names the IRI of the IEC 61360 data specification template that embeddedDataSpecifications must reference. What IRI does the constraint text give in the aas-core-meta formalisation of metamodel 3.1?
items.expected_answer: https://admin-shell.io/DataSpecificationTemplates/DataSpecificationIEC61360/3/0 (the same text appears in the 3.0 and 3.2 formalisations).

citation.document: IDTA-01003-a Part 3a Data Specification IEC 61360 (as formalised in aas-core-meta)

items.question: Which IRI must HasDataSpecification/dataSpecification reference for an IEC 61360 data specification under Part 3a v3.1.1, and what is the status of .../DataSpecificationIEC61360/3/0?
items.expected_answer: https://admin-shell.io/DataSpecificationTemplates/DataSpecificationIec61360/3 (AASc-3a-050). The /3/0 forms (IEC61360 or Iec61360 casing, http or https) are listed as deprecated, not as invalid.

citation.document: IDTA-01003-a Part 3a Data Specification IEC 61360 (official PDF, paged text)
citation.quote: shall contain the external reference to the IRI of the corresponding data specification template
